notes: τὸν πλησίον carries no genitive pronoun, so rule 20's second arm gives the supplied *his* to the article.
ὁλοκαυτωμάτων → *whole burnt offerings* heads on the -μα noun under rule 66, as *created thing* heads on *thing*; heading on *burnt* remains defensible.
Both articular infinitives leave the nominalizing article unrepresented under rule 61, no preposition governing them.
